content.body:
The list of available forces shows units that may be used for this mission. The columns show how many units of each type are available and what the total capacity of those units is. These numbers are the numbers for the brigade as a whole, not for each mission.
Not every unit type is available for every mission. For example, missions originating at Depots have only infantry and light AT and AA guns, and truck available - tanks and heavy guns are not available there regardless of how many the brigade currently has.
The Capacity column shows the maximum number of a unit available. These numbers can rise above their normal levels when players bring units from other brigades and place them with the brigade.
content.title: Available Forces
